items.title: On a connected scheme a bounded below constructible complex with locally constant cohomology is constant on an etale covering over finite projective modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma makes a locally constant constructible complex on a connected scheme globally constant on an etale covering, over a finite complex of finite projective modules (statement lines 13849-13856). The proof (proof lines 13858-13878) trivialises the complex on an etale covering, separates the covering into the disjoint open pieces indexed by the isomorphism class of the local model — using that etale morphisms are open and that U_i x_X U_j is empty for non-isomorphic models — and then uses connectedness together with the perfectness criterion to replace the surviving model by a finite complex of finite projective modules. H2: the same grouping argument as for locally constant sheaves, with one extra perfectness input.
